basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student from Helsinki, Finland, currently studying computer science. I recently got into gaming, particularly Apex Legends, and I'm still learning the ropes. Aside from gaming, I'm a huge fan of indie music, and I spend a lot of time exploring new bands. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after my classes and gaming sessions. I'm single and enjoy hanging out with friends on weekends, where we occasionally have LAN parties.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of gaming mechanics and strategies, primarily learned through YouTube tutorials and discussions with friends who are seasoned gamers. My knowledge is more focused on the technical aspects due to my studies in computer science.
